notes.title: Alien Attack v1.4 update
notes.notes:
Unexpected update is here!

Added:

 New palettes selection system: now you can buy palettes which you want the most, using points. The palette shop is in the main menu, below the "START" button.
 New skin ([spoiler]unlocked after getting "Palette Lover!" achievement[/spoiler]).
 Updated achievements' images: the game's visual style has changed since 2016, so there are new images.
 Smooth menus' navigations: it looks a lot cooler when they're smooth... right?
 Minor fixes


Have fun!

And don't forget to post bugs here if you find some.

notes.title: Alien Attack v1.2 update
notes.notes:
Added:

 Split-screen co-op (xbox gamepad + keyboard/mouse)
 Bot assistant ([spoiler]it helps you after "Score 500 points!" achievement is reached. It's not so smart but it can help you[/spoiler])
 Player selection menu (skin, control type)
 New soundtrack (Awesome Force)
 New enemies ([spoiler]including elites[/spoiler])
 New bosses
 New weapon ([spoiler]plasma blaster after 2nd boss instead of disintegrator[/spoiler])
 Voice announcer
 New palettes
 New logo
 New features
 New animations
 Updated some sprites
 Updated game mechanics
 Cheats

Enjoy your stay! 

And don't forget to post bugs here if you find some.
